appeared.description: Footprint 'R_0805_2012Metric' does not match copy in library 'Resistor_SMD'

absent.description: Footprint 'R_1206_3216Metric' does not match copy in library 'Resistor_SMD'

risks.consequence: Socket insertion damage, split barrel or annular breakout
risks.action: Fabricator to confirm all coupled process conditions in writing. Assembly engineer to gauge the actual connector and inspect a panel witness.

risks.consequence: Five assembled sockets may bind cards or foul bracket/tray despite nominal alignment
risks.action: Mechanical reviewer to gauge end stations, local bow, card plane, bracket and underside clearance with real hardware.

risks.consequence: Larger inner annuli restrict the auxiliary rails. New escapes can increase discontinuity or narrow return paths.
risks.action: PCB reviewer to inspect both plane layers and current path. Verify four-wire resistance, droop and temperature at loaded near/far slots and under simultaneous switching.

risks.consequence: Solder tails or the body can foul tray hardware or hinder RTC service
risks.action: Check lead form, body height, underside trim, extraction and standby operation.

risks.consequence: SIP common impedance changes overshoot, crosstalk and valid strobe window
risks.action: Bench owner to measure all three variants under matched conditions and then measure actual receiver pins in a loaded machine. Await the separate SDS1104X-U test-plan revision for instrument-specific limits.

risks.consequence: Apparent improvements in counts can mask a new fault
risks.action: Preserve original report, compare matching KiCad-version refills and classify each local difference. Keep inherited circuitry corrections in separately approved commits.

risks.consequence: DIP substitution, radial lead inductance, thermal limits and audio JFET pinouts can affect system timing or analogue response
risks.action: Check actual data sheets, pad maps, bypass loop and clearance by function. Keep the approved EATX electrical choices and compare measured performance.

risks.consequence: Axial lead seating and barrel solder fill affect the reset threshold connection.
risks.action: Inspect lead trim and solder fill and measure comparator input and reset switching over the supply ramp.

risks.consequence: Installed dense banks use 1.40 mm B.Cu lands with 1.60 mm on other copper layers and 0.80 mm finished holes. Etch, registration and mask errors can reduce rear clearance or residual annulus.
risks.action: Fabricator to guarantee actual minimum finished dimensions and overlay; inspect a plated witness and solder-fill cross section before release.

risks.consequence: The routed SIP trial sharply narrows all three auxiliary rails and interrupts the immediate reference beneath _OWN. Nine discrete returns remain installed.
risks.action: Review a different site or quantify an engineered rail bypass under loaded-slot conditions. Routed trial

risks.consequence: ZS5 lengthens four signal-side taps by up to 9.36 mm; ZS3 capacitors and adjacent SIP bodies have narrow nominal assembly gaps.
risks.action: Check near/far receiver settling, strobes and SIP ground bounce. Gauge actual body tolerance, card withdrawal, solder access and lead trim. ZS3 · ZS5

risks.risk: Axial assembly and chip socket access
risks.consequence: R305 and R306 have 0.994 mm centred body clearance. R305 is 0.042 mm from the D300 courtyard, and R101 is 0.030 mm from the Agnus socket courtyard.
risks.action: Verify formed-body offset, actual socket overhang, extraction-tool access and soldering access on a trial assembly. R305/R306 tolerance review · R101 placement

risks.consequence: The 1 Ω audio/video feeds and 10 Ω negative analogue feed see turn-on pulses. The two new 47 µF cans have specified impedance at one frequency.
risks.action: Measure loaded startup current, rail drop, resistor temperature and analogue ripple. Compare installed ESR/ESL and stereo noise against the reference board. Surge analysis · Rail filters

risks.risk: Axial control branches and radial POT inputs
risks.consequence: The revised branches add local pad clearances in their reference planes. The radial ceramics change the physical discharge loops on two controller inputs.
risks.action: Check loaded DOE, _OVR and control edges, reset ramps and all four controller axes. Confirm radial lead form and 7.36 mm seated envelope. Batch evidence and current holds

risks.consequence: Unknown baseline ESR/ESL and an 11 mm can affect Vref behaviour and harness clearance. The current board retains the SMD package.
risks.action: Compare loaded Vref and audio output, impedance and actual body clearance. Radial trial

risks.consequence: Eight switching branches share the SIP common. Ground connection and fit depend on assembled joints, available soldering heat and card clearance.
risks.action: Measure the assembled branch matrix, fit, common-ground bounce and loaded receiver response. The SDS1104X-U remains the available bench scope.
